serving.text_only_input_quote: I've been experiencing persistent headaches for the past week. What could be causing this?
serving.notes: generation_config.json has token ids only, no temperature or top_p. The card example sets max_new_tokens 256, temperature 0.7, top_p 0.9, do_sample True. config.json max_position_embeddings is 8192. Training max sequence length is stated as 1024. chat_template.jinja raises 'System role not supported' and maps assistant to the Gemma 'model' turn. tokenizer_config.json has no chat_template key and use_default_system_prompt false. No adapter_config.json. Published weights are three F32 shards (2,614,341,888 parameters), not a 4-bit file, while the card says 4-bit nf4 was used for training and inference. HF tag base_model:adapter:google/gemma-2-2b-it. The card does not say whether the LoRA was merged.

evaluation_reported.text: Not validated against clinical benchmarks. Quantization: 4-bit quantization maintains ~95% of full precision performance with significant memory savings.

discrepancies: Inventory methods are lora. The card says LoRA and 4-bit nf4 quantization for training, which is QLoRA. The dataset id and parent match. The card says a curated 1,500-row subset, not the full Hub set (112,165 rows). The card does not name a loss.
